title: Evolution Collage: UX Snapshot Pack for Release Highlights
creator: Riley Chen
description: Create a compact, reusable image pack for the upcoming release announcement and changelog post. The pack (named 'Evolution Collage') will provide modular before/after UI comparisons, mobile/desktop crops, and feature callouts designed for the blog hero, social cards, and docs embeds. Deliverables: multi-frame hero strip, 3 single-frame callouts, 4 device-specific crops, and source Figma file with export presets.
acceptance_criteria: Hero strip (1600x900) with annotated before/after frames exported as PNG and SVG-friendly PDF
Three individual feature callouts exported in desktop and mobile sizes with accessible contrast and annotated callout pins
All assets sourced from staging environment screenshots (staging-2026.redwood.ai) with anonymized data
Figma file includes named export presets, component variants, and measurement tokens for handoff to marketing
Design review signed off by PM and one engineering reviewer; assets uploaded to drive folder with README
tasks: Audit current UI snapshots in docs (doc screenshots folder) to identify diffs needed
Schedule screenshot capture window with QA/Eng to ensure stable staging responses
Create layout system in Figma: hero strip + modular callouts + mobile crops
Design accessibility-checked callout pins and microcopy for feature highlights
Export assets at required sizes and compress for web use (webp/png) and upload to marketing drive
Write README with usage examples, alt text recommendations, and export specs

decisions: Use split-frame composition (before | after) for hero strip to emphasize outcome of change
Export primary assets as both PNG and compressed WebP; provide SVG-like PDF for editorial uses
Anonymize all user data in screenshots; use synthetic placeholder names provided by QA team

Incorporate PM contrast feedback and produce alternate color variants for A/B testing
Finalize exports and upload to Drive; add alt text and suggested copy snippets for blog and tweet cards
Request marketing sign-off and attach approved assets to release checklist
